item.description:
Insight 0.2.4

  • Your API key is now checked when you save it and again before a meeting starts — a key the provider rejects is never stored over a working one, and you won’t reach “Listening” with a key that can’t produce insights.
  • If insights stop coming through mid-meeting because the key was rejected, Insight now tells you instead of sitting silently on “Listening.”
  • Added a warning when several insight calls in a row fail in a way that looks like an exhausted plan — a heads-up that you may be out of credits.
  • Added a Remove key button in Settings to clear the saved key for the selected provider.
  • Until a provider and key are set up, the overlay now shows just the setup prompt and “Start Listening” stays disabled — so you can’t start a session that couldn’t produce insights.
